limits: The corpus covers four producers and includes commands and code from two. The EmacsConf narration-free demo has no speech reference. The source timestamp and code reference geometry are bound to each normalized file.

selection_amendment.reason: A fourth independent producer with a complete talk adds visible code and terminal references beyond the EmacsConf demo.
selection_amendment.screening: Unscored source-video contact sheets. No extraction output or annotation labels were used.
selection_amendment.other_candidates: The Embedded C/C++ talk is scheduled at twice the length. Org-Babel would repeat the existing EmacsConf producer. Neither other recording was evaluated.
selection_amendment.license_scope: The first shortlist preferred CC BY and CC BY-SA. The frozen rule accepts openly licensed recordings with clear attribution. DebConf25 explicitly distributes this recording under its MIT/Expat video policy.
selection_amendment.retained_exclusion: DebConf18 was not part of this pre-run shortlist amendment. The original screening record and reasons remain available.
